thread:
leo_procurement: heads up — vendor Xpress just confirmed partial allocation for the H100 batch. 20 units EU, 10 US. ETA options: consolidated sea (cheaper) or air split (faster).
anya_logistics: can we do mixed? send 10 air EU urgent, rest sea? EU cluster is in regen mode rn.
sam_sre: our eu-west1 pool is at 62% capacity, queue increasing for GPU jobs — if we don't get >=8 units in 3 days we hit latency SLO on heavy-replay tests. :grimacing:
maria_ops: @leo_procurement can we ask vendor for RMA-ready serials for the urgent 10? need them labelled for depot swap to avoid extra customs hold.
vendor_xpress: Confirmed we can air 10 EU units with pre-printed RMA labels and invoice grouping under one AWB. Sea shipment will be grouped in a single container but no RMA labels pre-attached. Extra fee for air-label prep is $120/unit.
leo_procurement: pricing tradeoff: air + label prep = $120/unit prep + air premium (~$2.5k per shipment). Sea = $0 prep but potential 7–10 day customs delay. Is immediate capacity worth ~ $14k?
anya_logistics: if air gets in in 48–72h and we can swap in-depot same day, that buys us a week of scheduling slack. Also avoids temporary loaners.
sam_sre: temporary loaners would be 8 H100-equivalent vCPUs on dedicated pool — cost estimate was ~$6k wk. Operational risk higher (different firmware). Not ideal.
maria_ops: also note DOA risk — if any arrive DOA with air, vendor has 24h RMA SLA on replacement. Sea replacements take 7–14 days. That SLA matters given cluster churn.
leo_procurement: ok propose: air 10 EU w/ RMA labels prep, invoice grouping, and a 7-day holdback insurance. Sea rest via standard container. Ask vendor for a credit if any serials fail QC on arrival.
vendor_xpress: we can do 5% arrival credit for serial failures (refund of unit cost), can bump to 7% if we take a larger sea batch. We will provide `AWB: XPR-EU-9988` for air.
anya_logistics: please add HS code and import docs to the air manifest — customs flagged a previous shipment for missing HS and held for 2d. 
leo_procurement: noted. @vendor_xpress please include HS: 8471.80.10 and attach scanned commercial invoice in the AWB doc.
vendor_xpress: done — invoice attached to AWB, HS included. ETA air arrival 2026-04-12 14:00 CET. Sea ETD 2026-04-09, ETA 2026-04-21.
sam_sre: scheduling note — when the air batch hits depot, we need automated canary to stage 2 racks with firmware image `h100-rt-2026-03-30`. deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created for `h100-rt-2026-03-30` on arrival.
maria_ops: ops checklist for inbound EU air: 1) verify serials vs manifest 2) tag with RMA label 3) run quick thermal health check 4) push to staging. I'll assign ops team.
leo_procurement: one more wrinkle — vendor asks for payment terms change for the air tranche (net 7 vs net 30) due to premium carrier. Thoughts?
anya_logistics: we can front the carrier premium from the logistics budget if procurement keeps net30 for unit cost. splitting payment avoids cash hit.
leo_procurement: agree. I'll sign net30 for unit cost, vendor to invoice separate carrier fee net7.
sam_sre: reminder — if any unit fails thermal check, follow RMA flow `rma/expedite` and log in ops-ticketing with tag `rma-priority`. Also capture serial+fw in ticket.
maria_ops: will do. tagging: @ops-team please standby Tues-Wed for inbound window. :white_check_mark:
vendor_xpress: AWB live: https://tracking.xpress/track/XPR-EU-9988 — notify when customs release. We will also send sea BL once container leaves.
leo_procurement: thanks — next steps: 1) finalize carrier split + invoice instructions 2) ops ready for receipt 3) sam to wire canary steps. I'll update PO and push change order.
sam_sre: noted. adding capacity alert: if we don't hit 70% pool capacity by 2026-04-15 we'll trigger temporary loaner procurement.
anya_logistics: closing loop on customs — I've prebooked brokerage and set a secondary broker in case of hold.
maria_ops: ops assigned: Javier, Mei, Priya. They have the RMA label printing template.
leo_procurement: cool — I'll confirm payment split with finance. Anybody object?
anya_logistics: no objections. :thumbsup:
vendor_xpress: will send final invoices and shipping docs in 1h.
sam_sre: thanks all. updating incident dashboard with expected capacity bump when air is in.
leo_procurement: great, thread closed unless customs flags.
metadata_note: This thread outlines procurement/ops coordination for an urgent mixed freight H100 shipment with RMA labeling, pricing split, customs, and capacity canary. Messages are concise per Slack style.
